learned_patterns.pattern: The binding constraint on this book is not signal quality — it is that session outputs never reach main. Every session writes to an isolated feature branch; the live site and the between-session fractional monitor read main, so both froze at 2026-06-30 for 20 days while the Signal Engine output (also on main) went stale, forcing perpetual SAFE MODE. Fix the merge-to-main path (or repoint consumers) before any strategy tuning matters.

INTC's stop was $112.06 but it filled at $109.01 on 07-07 — a ~2.7% gap-through. This is exactly the between-session overnight-gap risk the framework warns about for fractional positions: the manual/monitor stop caps tail risk but cannot prevent a gap already opened. Reinforces the §13 thesis of migrating single names toward lower-volatility ETFs.

For the second time, an agentic fill (INTC sell 07-07) executed but was never written to memory by the session that placed it — surfaced only via §3 broker+orders reconciliation. Always reconcile positions AND recent orders every session; the broker is truth (§5.1), prose memory lags.

With a 20-day-old matrix, gate values are not merely imprecise, they are wrong (MU 1164->866, CRWD 763->198). SAFE MODE (§2.5) correctly blocks any entry off such data. The discipline held: 0 trades, no forced action on a stale tape.

SOXX -14% / QQQ -4% since 06-30 with zero action is by design — CORE carries no stop (§13); the tier is the compounding base and declines are reinvestment opportunities. Only LAB (ATR stops) and the DRIP no-sell rule generate position-level actions.
